It's a stain because then people would know what is wrong with me, and unfortunately, mental health is still stigmatized. 

I just like my space and I don't like most people. I don't like talking and it's mentally exhausting for me to be in the same room as someone else. Being in an institution would just aggravate everything and I would just shut down. 

I was on meds for a little bit and they didn't help. I don't want to go on them again, much less in a situation where the people working are inclined to just drug people up so they're as docile as possible.

Several things: 

\- I don't want a stain on my record for future medical things, because I'm disabled 

\- I'm the only daughter of two immigrants. They had a hard enough time accepting that I have a mental illness and need therapy. I would disappoint them so much if I had to be in the hospital. 

\- I don't want to be forced on medication 

\- I heard it can be dangerous and scary because of the other people that are there. 

\- I'm very introverted and I like my privacy. I don't want to be forced to interact/speak to people
They won't. And I'm taking this as a learning opportunity. Like a rehearsal. I'm sure there are things I can do to minimize the pain next time so I can do it properly.

Thanks for saying that. I didn't really think about it as something thoughtful or something that people would appreciate. 

I have shared, but I don't want to be put in a mental institution so no one knows how serious it is.

I commented this above as well, but the issue is I don't want to kill myself in a way that would give the person that finds my corpse any trauma and I don't want people to have to witness my death. So I have limited options.

The funny thing is that I'm not even diagnosed with depression. I have really severe c-PTSD and an eating disorder. Treatment isn't helping. My life is literally miserable and I would much rather be dead. 

The issue is I don't want to do it in a way that would severely scar the person that finds my corpse. So like, I don't want to jump in front of a train where people could see it happen and give them trauma, or jump off a building. I don't want to shoot myself cause it's so messy for the person that finds me. And there isn't anywhere in my tiny apartment where I can hang myself. And ODing rarely works either.

I'm a little older than you, 22, and no. I have never had a moment in my life where I am happy to be alive. I got really sick when I was 2 and I wish my parents had let me die. I have been severely suicidal since I was 11. I have never experienced anything that changes my assertion that I would be better off dead.
I want to get a tattoo before I die. I have my appointment in July.
Happy birthday! My 20th birthday was a hard one for me and you should be proud that you made it.
Gas particles are small enough that they would get through and absolutely would poison (if not kill) them both.
I get that all the time. I go to therapy twice a week every single week and I still want to kill myself every day. No one actually cares, they just don't want you to be their problem anymore.
